title: IMAGAgent: Orchestrating Multi-Turn Image Editing via Constraint-Aware Planning and Reflection
abstract: arXiv:2603.29602v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing multi-turn image editing paradigms are often confined to isolated single-step execution. Due to a lack of context-awareness and closed-loop feedback mechanisms, they are prone to error accumulation and semantic drift during multi-turn interactions, ultimately resulting in severe structural distortion of the generated images. To address this, we propose IMAGAgent, a multi-turn image editing agent framework based on a ``plan--execute--reflect'' closed-loop mechanism that achieves deep synergy among instruction parsing, tool scheduling, and adaptive correction within a unified pipeline. Specifically, we first present a constraint-aware planning module that leverages a vision-language model (VLM) to precisely decompose complex natural language instructions into a series of executable sub-tasks, governed by target singularity, semantic atomicity, and visual perceptibility. translated_title: IMAGAgent：通过约束感知规划与反思实现多轮图像编辑的编排
translated_abstract: 现有的多轮图像编辑范式通常局限于孤立的单步执行。由于缺乏上下文感知能力和闭环反馈机制，它们在多轮交互过程中容易产生误差累积和语义漂移，最终导致生成图像出现严重的结构失真。为解决这一问题，我们提出了IMAGAgent，这是一个基于“规划—执行—反思”闭环机制的多轮图像编辑智能体框架，在统一流程中实现了指令解析、工具调度和自适应修正的深度协同。具体而言，我们首先提出了一个约束感知规划模块，该模块利用视觉语言模型（VLM）将复杂的自然语言指令精确分解为一系列可执行的子任务，并遵循目标单一性、语义原子性和视觉可感知性三项原则。随后，工具链编排模块动态……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了IMAGAgent多轮图像编辑智能体框架，通过“规划—执行—反思”闭环机制，利用约束感知规划模块将复杂指令分解为可执行子任务，并结合工具链编排与自适应修正，有效缓解了多轮交互中的误差累积与语义漂移问题。
en_tdlr: IMAGAgent is a multi-turn image editing agent framework built on a "plan-execute-reflect" closed-loop mechanism, which uses constraint-aware planning with a VLM to decompose complex instructions into executable sub-tasks and orchestrates tool chains with adaptive reflection to mitigate error accumulation and semantic drift in multi-turn editing.
